def clean(df):
    df = df[df['sex'].notna()]
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip()
    df = df[df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female'])]
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(float, errors='coerce')
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'].notna()) & (df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    groups = df['sex'].unique()
    result = {}
    for group in groups:
        avg = df[df['sex'] == group]['body_mass_g'].mean()
        result[group] = avg
    return result
